lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  profile_tactic "hu" in (have hu : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by fun_prop)
  have h₀ : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0)
  profile_tactic "obtain" in (obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hu.continuousAt h₀))
  profile_tactic "letB" in (let B : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩)
  profile_tactic "k1" in (have k1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B := B.contDiff)
  profile_tactic "k2" in (have k2 : HasCompactSupport B := B.hasCompactSupport)
  profile_tactic "k3" in (have k3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : Y => f x₀) := contDiff_const)
  profile_tactic "k4" in (have k4 : IsTestFunction (fun x => B x • f x₀) :=
    IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨k1, k2⟩ k3)
  profile_tactic "k5" in (have key := hg (fun x => B x • f x₀) k4)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => B x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := B.continuous.mul hu
  have hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := fun x => by
    rcases lt_or_ge (dist x x₀) δ with h | h
    · exact mul_nonneg B.nonneg (hδ h).le
    · rw [B.zero_of_le_dist h, zero_mul]
  have hp : 0 < ∫ x, B x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
    integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero hc
      (hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.mul_right k2)) hn
      (mul_ne_zero (B.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0)).ne' h₀.ne')
  exact hp.ne' key
